hooks.name: Prettier check on save
hooks.description: CI fails on `pnpm format:check`. Checking the saved file with Prettier catches formatting drift immediately and cheaply, unlike a full lint or typecheck.

action.prompt: A file was saved. Run `pnpm exec prettier --check <saved file path>` from the repo root. If it fails, run `pnpm exec prettier --write <saved file path>` and mention it in one line. Do nothing else.
